g.text: Purchase Request Workflow — Orchestration with Human Approval
submit structured purchase data + revision + orchestration
commit purchase request + run + READY cursor + trace
create/get work item; set purchase request/run WAITING; trace
persist next cursor or terminal + trace
commit decision + purchase request outcome + READY cursor + trace
Central control stops at WAITING and returns; it never blocks for a person.
Business failure and rejection route without automatic retry.
Automated acceptance exercises the same waiting/resume sequence.
